attn_mask.polarity: White zones (1.0) get maximum IP-Adapter influence, Black zones (0.0) are unaffected.
attn_mask.resize_behavior: Resized automatically to match latent size/aspect ratio.
attn_mask.mask_inversion_supported: By manually inverting the input mask before passing it

notes: The mask defines the area of influence on the final generated image. It does not limit reference-image encoding (which is handled by CLIP Vision), but instead masks the cross-attention layers in the U-Net where IP-Adapter features are injected.
